title: BG source NSClientV3 is missing BG values
symptom: Since switching to NSClientV3 on a test phone, AAPS is missing BG values when the phone's lockscreen activates. Reopening the app updates to the latest BG value and resumes updating. The issue started after upgrading Nightscout to v15.0.0.
cause: The thread identifies that websockets do not work with Nightscout v15.0.0-dev when using NSClientV3 for download-only BG source, causing missed BG values.
fix: Switch off 'connect to websockets' in NSClient settings.
evidence_quote: Switched off "connect to websockets" and it started to work
